map.10 吨货 800 km 的运输方式对比: Comparing transport modes for 10 tons over 800 km
map.重量 10 t、距离 800 km、年 24 次。柴油货车因子 0.062 kg: Weight 10 t, distance 800 km, 24 trips per year. Diesel truck factor 0.062 kgCO₂/ton-km: single trip 0.062×10×800=496 kg, annual 11 904 kg≈11.9 tCO₂. Switching to rail (0.010): single trip 80 kg, annual 1 920 kg≈1.92 tCO₂, annual reduction about 9.98 tCO₂, a drop of about 84%. If switched to a battery-electric truck (0.020): single trip 160 kg, annual 3.84 tCO₂, a reduction of about 68%.
